title: Signed shifts of fixed normalized tensor reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and an isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible. Let D be a PodCompletionReindex satisfying its Laws and T a PodCompletedTensorReindex over D satisfying its Laws. There are signed tensor-shift models SY at Y and SX at X such that PodReindexSignedShifts g D T SY SX holds. This includes CommShift for the actual reduction and limit maps, both signed limit/Roos equations, both tensor-shift generator and representative-model equations and the left- and right-factor tensor squares for every integer shift. Definitions: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization], [def-pod-completion-reindex-shifts].

proof.text: construct left and right tensor-shift comparisons by relabeling the total tensor summands on flat-term K-flat representatives. The right comparison has the Koszul factor (-1)^(pr); the left comparison has its prescribed sign. The signed total differentials verify these are chain isomorphisms for every integer shift, and the quotient transitions commute with them. Localize these maps to get SY and SX with their Generators laws. Apply the same two-coordinate Roos realization used in T.Model to obtain their Model laws. On a shifted Roos complex the second coordinate is multiplied by (-1)^r, while the first is the projection-defined shift/product comparison. D.shiftSource.Laws and D.shiftTarget.Laws fix exactly these maps. D.LimitModel therefore supplies the two PodLimitSignedShift identities. On the coherent reduction system, shifting commutes with the quotient tensor generator map, proving CommShift of D.reduction.hom; the diagonal Roos equation proves CommShift of D.limit.hom. Finally reindexing preserves degrees and integer signs, so both tensor-shift squares agree on all homogeneous summands and descend through T.Model. This verifies negative shifts, shift zero, empty schemes and zero inputs too. .

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorSignedShifts
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T) :
    ∃ SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y, ∃ SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X,
      PodReindexSignedShifts l E g D T SY SX
